subject: Cannot process payment
body: I've been trying to update my credit card information for the past hour but the payment page keeps showing an error. My subscription is about to expire and I don't want to lose access.

subject: Dashboard not loading
body: When I try to access my dashboard, I just see a blank white screen. I've tried multiple browsers and cleared my cache but nothing works. This started happening after your latest update.

subject: Forgot my password
body: I can't remember my password and the reset email isn't arriving in my inbox. I've checked spam folder as well. Please help me regain access to my account.

subject: Feature request: Dark mode
body: Would love to see a dark mode option added to the application. I work late hours and the bright interface is straining my eyes. Many other tools have this feature now.

subject: Charged twice this month
body: I noticed two charges on my credit card statement for this month's subscription. Can you please refund the duplicate charge? Transaction IDs: TXN123456 and TXN123457

subject: API returning 500 errors
body: Our integration has been receiving 500 internal server errors from your API endpoint /v1/users for the past 3 hours. This is blocking our production deployment.

subject: Export to CSV not working
body: When I click the export button to download my data as CSV, nothing happens. No error message, no download. Tried on Chrome and Firefox.

subject: Need to update billing address
body: I've recently moved and need to update my billing address for tax purposes. How can I change this in my account settings?

subject: Request: Slack integration
body: It would be amazing if you could integrate with Slack so we can receive notifications directly in our workspace channels. This would improve our team's workflow significantly.

subject: Mobile app crashes on startup
body: The iOS app crashes immediately after opening. I'm on iPhone 14 with iOS 17.2. Tried reinstalling but same issue. App version 2.3.1

subject: Cannot add team members
body: Getting an error 'Maximum users reached' when trying to add a new team member, but I'm on the Business plan which allows 20 users and I only have 12.

subject: Requesting invoice for last month
body: I need a detailed invoice for November's charges for our accounting department. Can you send it to accounting@company.com?

subject: Data not syncing across devices
body: Changes I make on my desktop don't appear on my mobile app even after waiting several hours. The sync feature seems broken.

subject: Suggestion: Keyboard shortcuts
body: As a power user, I'd love to have keyboard shortcuts for common actions like creating new items, searching, and navigating between sections. This would speed up my workflow.

subject: SSL certificate error
body: Getting a security warning about an invalid SSL certificate when accessing app.yoursite.com. Browser says the certificate expired 2 days ago.

subject: Downgrade my subscription
body: I'd like to downgrade from Pro to Basic plan. What happens to my data and when will the change take effect?

subject: Email notifications not arriving
body: I've enabled email notifications in settings but I'm not receiving any emails. My email is correct and I've checked spam folder.

subject: Request: API rate limit increase
body: Our application is growing and we're hitting the API rate limit of 1000 requests/hour. Can we get this increased to 5000 for our use case?

subject: Search function returning wrong results
body: When I search for specific terms, I get completely unrelated results. The search used to work fine but seems broken after the latest update.

subject: Annual plan pricing question
body: What's the discount if I switch from monthly to annual billing? Also, will I get a prorated refund for the remaining days of my current month?

subject: File upload fails for large files
body: I can't upload files larger than 10MB. The upload starts but then fails with a timeout error. My plan says I can upload up to 100MB files.

subject: Two-factor authentication not working
body: I enabled 2FA but now I can't log in. The code from my authenticator app is being rejected as invalid. I'm locked out of my account.

subject: Feature idea: Templates
body: Would be super helpful to have templates for common use cases so we don't have to set up the same configuration repeatedly.

subject: Webhook not triggering
body: I've configured a webhook URL but it's not receiving any events. Tested the endpoint separately and it works fine. Webhook ID: WHK-78945

subject: Cancel subscription and delete account
body: I need to cancel my subscription and have all my data deleted per GDPR. Please confirm when this is completed.

subject: UI elements overlapping on mobile
body: On my Android phone, the buttons and text are overlapping making it impossible to use the app. Screenshots attached. Using Samsung Galaxy S22.

subject: Timezone incorrect in reports
body: All my reports are showing times in UTC but my account is set to EST. The timestamps are off by 5 hours.

subject: Student discount inquiry
body: Do you offer student discounts? I'm currently enrolled full-time and would love to use your service for my coursework.

subject: Request: Batch operations
body: Need ability to perform actions on multiple items at once instead of one by one. This would save so much time for bulk updates.

subject: Login stuck in infinite loop
body: After entering credentials, the login page just reloads instead of taking me to dashboard. Happens on both desktop and mobile.

subject: Character encoding issue
body: Special characters and emojis are showing as question marks or boxes. Tried different browsers. This breaks our internationalization.

subject: Refund request
body: I was charged for the Pro plan but I never upgraded. I only wanted the Basic plan. Please refund the difference.

subject: PDF export has formatting issues
body: When exporting reports to PDF, the tables are cut off and images don't appear. The HTML version looks fine.

subject: Permission settings not saving
body: I set specific permissions for a team member but they reset back to default after a few hours. Happened three times now.

subject: Enhancement: Google Calendar integration
body: Would be fantastic to sync events with Google Calendar. Many competitors have this and it's a key feature we need.

subject: Cannot delete my account
body: There's no option in settings to delete my account. I no longer need the service and want my data removed.

subject: Database connection timeout
body: Keep getting 'database connection timeout' errors when loading large datasets. This makes the platform unusable for our needs.

subject: Enterprise plan pricing
body: Can you send me information about enterprise pricing for 100+ users? Also need details on SLA and support options.

subject: Sorting not working correctly
body: When I click to sort by date, items appear in random order. Ascending and descending both show the same incorrect order.

subject: Feature request: Multi-language support
body: Please add support for Spanish and French. Our team is international and this would help adoption significantly.

subject: Payment method declined
body: My payment method was declined but the card is valid and has sufficient funds. Tried a different card and same issue.

subject: Comments not posting
body: When I try to add comments on items, I see a loading spinner but the comment never appears. No error message shown.

subject: Change account owner
body: I need to transfer account ownership to a colleague. How can I do this without losing our data and settings?

subject: Request: REST API documentation
body: Is there comprehensive API documentation available? I can't find detailed info on all available endpoints and parameters.

subject: Charts not rendering
body: The analytics dashboard shows blank spaces where charts should be. Console shows JavaScript errors related to chart library.

subject: Trial extension request
body: My 14-day trial is ending tomorrow but I need a few more days to properly evaluate for our team of 50. Can you extend it?

subject: Duplicate entries appearing
body: I'm seeing duplicate entries of the same items in my list. When I delete one, both disappear. Database sync issue?

subject: Idea: Version history
body: Would be great to have version history so we can see previous versions of items and restore them if needed. Like Google Docs.

subject: CORS error in API
body: Getting CORS policy errors when calling your API from our frontend. Tried adding headers but still blocked. API endpoint: /v1/data

subject: Tax exemption certificate
body: We're a non-profit organization. How do we submit our tax exemption certificate to avoid being charged sales tax?
